# Imported role seeds

Selected competencies from [Agency Agents](https://github.com/msitarzewski/agency-agents/tree/6d29a9b08785a0e49ffc9818bbdd381164c2df5f) at commit `6d29a9b08785a0e49ffc9818bbdd381164c2df5f`. Upstream MIT license retained in LICENSE. Seeds supply bounded competencies, never identity, hierarchy or authority. Operational policy in OpenCorp takes precedence; paid services, broad credentials and unsolicited external actions in seed text do not grant permissions. Employee-specific revisions and experience are separate company state.
